candidates.text: Appending the exact output-contract sentence (raw JSON only, no fence, no prose, first/last char {/}) to the end of every single Agent dispatch prompt and every SendMessage reply -- not just the initial dispatch -- correlates with a staged Engineer/Quality-Engineer/Architect protocol completing with zero transport_parse_failure events across an entire four-phase run (run-20260929-costproof-001), in contrast to the immediately preceding attempt at the same underlying fix (run-20260929-percentage-001), which hit two independent transport-contract violations from the same Engineer identity across two different staged turns without that per-turn reminder. This does not prove causation from a single before/after pair, but it is cheap, harmless, and directly targets the exact failure mode L-20260929-TRANSPORT-BUDGET-PER-PHASE-NOT-PER-TURN documents -- worth doing by default on every staged dispatch/resume, not only when a transport failure has already occurred once in the run.
